svg.title: From the hunt to your gear
svg.desc: Random battles: each enemy defeated has a 25% chance to leave its common material, 16 tiers from Bit Shard to Obsidian Digizoid by the enemy's level. Rare Targets drop rare Cores, one per region, 71 in all. The forge in every shop asks for a common on every piece of gear (2 to 40) and also a Core from 9,500 Bits, two from 50,000: it gives the shop's equipment, some reworked as Speed, Elemental, Tank or Trade-off variants. The Black Market trades one Core for 12 commons, sells 16 Legendary replicas for 2 Cores plus 20,000 to 40,000 Bits, and the Hunter's Mark for 2 Cores plus 50,000 Bits, which doubles rare drops. The DRI Gauntlet's 5 evolution lines, unlocked once with commons and Cores, give the Power accessories in tiers 1, 2 and S.
svg.text: From the hunt to your gear
Battles drop the materials; three places turn them into equipment.
Gear asks for a common too:
Up to 99 of each. A replica resells for 0 Bits.
